problem_statement: The strto* integer conversion interfaces document explicit bases in the range 2 through 36, and the digit-acceptance helper already supports alphabetic digits through base 36, but the shared base-validation helper rejects every explicit base above 26 with EINVAL. As a result, converting strings with a valid explicit base of 27 or higher (e.g. strtoul('A!','',27) through base 36) returns 0 and sets errno to EINVAL instead of returning the expected positional value. Bases below 2 and above 36 must remain invalid. The new test fails at the first base-27 assertion with the old kernel and passes with the fix.
